paragraphs: Search for companies using structured definitions. How It Works Provide a structured definition of your target companies in the definition field — our AI will find matching companies. All other filters are optional. See the request schema below for the full list of available filters. Definition examples: "YouTube video summarization tool" "electronic signature platform" "AI B2B SaaS" "real estate company" AI Enrichment Use the criteria parameter to score companies against custom criteria. Each company will be evaluated and scored (0-5) with reasoning for each criterion. Pricing First 10 results are free (including AI enrichment) A positive credit balance is required for every request, free results included (an organization at 0 credits gets a 402) Entirely-free requests are limited per organization by plan: free 50/day + 10/min · starter 200/day + 15/min · growth 500/day + 20/min · pro 750/day + 25/min · agency 1500/day + 30/min · enterprise 3000/day + 30/min (429 beyond); billable requests are not affected 0.5 credits per company after the first 10 +0.1 credits per company per criterion after the first 10 Example: 150 companies with 2 criteria = 50 billable × (0.5 + 0.1 × 2) = 35 credits (first 10 are free) Empty results = 0 credits. Deduplication Pass dedup list ids in exclude_lists to skip companies you already own — they are not returned and not charged. Free results zone does not apply. See the Deduplication endpoints.
Search for companies using structured definitions.

Provide a structured definition of your target companies in the definition field — our AI will find matching companies. All other filters are optional. See the request schema below for the full list of available filters.
Use the criteria parameter to score companies against custom criteria. Each company will be evaluated and scored (0-5) with reasoning for each criterion.
Example: 150 companies with 2 criteria = 50 billable × (0.5 + 0.1 × 2) = 35 credits (first 10 are free)
Pass dedup list ids in exclude_lists to skip companies you already own — they are not returned and not charged. Free results zone does not apply. See the Deduplication endpoints.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Search filters. Only definition is required. Use criteria for AI enrichment (+0.1 credits per company per criterion).

parameters.name: exclude_lists
parameters.description: Ids of your dedup lists (see Deduplication endpoints). Results already present in these lists are excluded and never charged. When set, the free results zone does not apply. Max 100 lists / 500000 values combined per request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of companies per page. Default: 100, max: 1000.
Invalid or missing API key. Include X-API-Key header.
Insufficient credit balance. Every request needs a positive balance, including requests that fall entirely inside the free results zone. Top up your account.
Validation error. Check request body and parameters.

Rate limit exceeded (10000/hour), concurrent limit reached (150 per organization), or free preview quota exceeded (search requests entirely within the free results zone; the quota depends on your plan).
Internal server error. Contact support if persists.
Request timeout. Please try again later.
